stories.headline: Neural networks are clean
stories.summary: Neural Networks Are Already Clean The cause of polysemanticity in early model organisms wasn’t superposition, but several ordinary, mostly fixable issues.  We can now understand most neurons in models up to trillions of parameters, and think the outlook for mechanistic interpretability may be far better than we thought.
